description: Numbered mathematical inventory and automated source-level scope comparison. Endpoint existence and mechanical proof verification are distinct from complete literal statement correspondence.
review_method: Automated source and statement comparison; no human mathematical review is asserted. Scope details are in docs/COVERAGE.md and docs/FIDELITY.md; mechanical evidence is separately recorded in docs/VERIFICATION.md.

results.title: Minimax bracket with a logarithmic gap
results.scope_notes: Selected exact target. RMS risk in the original model, `s>1`, `d>4s`, exact polynomial exponent, density-ratio parameter, stretched-exponential constant and logarithmic powers. Positive constants and threshold precede every extension domain and sample size.

results.title: Minimax exponent corollary
results.scope_notes: Selected exact targets. Both follow from the proved main bracket. Polynomial constants precede every positive epsilon; the eventual threshold can depend on epsilon. The additional stretch limit, logarithmic expansion and normalized-risk limit are proved consequences, not additional numbered paper blocks.

results.title: Exact minimax rate for 0<s<=1
results.scope_notes: Selected exact fixed-domain target. Common reciprocal constant for `max(n^(-1/2), n^(-4s/(d+4s)))`, all `n≥1`, `0<s≤1`, and positive integer dimension. Includes `s=1`, `n=1` and `d=4s`. Its constant is chosen after the fixed model, including its extension domain; a single constant quantified before all extension domains is not separately asserted.

results.title: Exact parametric rate for s>1,d<=4s
results.scope_notes: Selected exact fixed-domain target. Common reciprocal root-n constant, all `n≥1`, `s>1`, `d≤4s`, including the critical dimension. The same domain-quantifier limitation as 1.3 applies.

results.title: Elementary upper rates in every regime
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual measurable estimators for all `n≥1`, full piecewise exponent with `t=min(s,1)`, constant before all extension domains.

results.title: Uniform residual-projection upper bound
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual clipped Borel estimator and sum-form L2 risk for all `n≥1`, uniformly over domains. A rectangular monomial basis replaces the total-degree basis, enlarging only a fixed model-dependent feature count and constant.

results.title: Common independent affine pair-pilot risk
results.scope_notes: Conditional target. Explicit primitive pilot moment and localization assumptions, independent pilot/evaluation laws, sample fractions and floor guards. Response coordinates are allowed to be unbounded with the required finite moments. Product pilot measures realize independence. The special floor is derived; the general floor version assumes the actual mean guard.

results.title: Upper bound with the identified kappa
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. The first theorem constructs a measurable estimator and bounds its actual worst-case risk; the second takes the minimax infimum. Constants and threshold precede extension domains.

results.title: Anchored monomial features and spectral similarity
results.scope_notes: Quantitative component targets. Concrete monomial Gram matrices and similarity transport. Nonempty feature hypotheses are satisfied in the paper's positive-dimensional high-smoothness regime.

results.title: Population-fit error, increment decay and telescoping
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual model-derived spatial fit error, increment decay and finite telescoping; no desired approximation or risk conclusion is a premise.

results.title: Degree-uniform increment polynomial guarantees
results.scope_notes: Components. Concrete polynomial and error declarations exist. Generic matrix spectral/complex-neighborhood guards are conditional analytic infrastructure, followed by actual population specialization. The entire multi-clause paper statement is distributed across declarations.

results.title: Centered Taylor identity and variance localization
results.scope_notes: Conditional quantitative targets. Actual field-integral estimates under finite measure, L2 test and kernel hypotheses. Feature maps/dimensions can vary with the field point; no coefficient-norm integrability is imposed. The generic observation sigma algebra is countably generated, automatic for the paper's standard Borel observation domain. Arbitrary measurable spaces without this qualification are not covered.

results.scope_notes: Components. Actual weak-test fluctuations and joint measurability under primitive allocation admissibility. The listed endpoints do not alone combine every pilot proposition clause; the final upper-risk proof also uses the common pair bound.

results.title: One allocation for admissibility, bias, variance and rate
results.scope_notes: Components. Rounded allocation, eventual admissibility/noise/variance and bias budgets, assembled by the sharp upper proof. Individual budget endpoints are not each the complete numbered allocation lemma.

results.title: Score-to-risk comparison for mixture paths
results.scope_notes: Conditional target. Actual Markov sample laws, variance path in the original interval, exceptional mass, centered square-integrable score, absolute continuity and derivative identity. The original interval-width penalty is retained. Differentiation for bounded estimators used by clipping suffices for the risk conclusion.

results.title: Lower bound with the identified kappa
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual original-model minimax risk; no prior-existence, spatial-energy, assumed-risk or minimax-bracket premise. The proof constructs the necessary source, geometry, path and exceptional-tail witnesses. Constants and threshold precede extension domains.

results.title: Legality and normalized density margins
results.scope_notes: Quantitative legality components. The intrinsic paper frame constant and coefficient ball give global original Hölder norm bounds. Actual normalized ternary parameters are admissible at `eta0=rho/2^(d+1)`, under the stated raw density/mass/amplitude guards, uniformly over extension domains.

results.title: Separated cardinal interpolation and all three estimates
results.scope_label: Components, with an adapted band representation
results.scope_notes: Components, with an adapted band representation. Actual symmetric/permutation-invariant continuous matrices, exact diagonal weights in [0,1], monotonicity, separated costs and band-square estimates. Bands use two positive tagged copies with opposite amplitudes; a factor 2 is absorbed in a fixed constant. Below-one cutoff identities supply empty scales. The paper's linear integrated deficit target has complementary-tail components in CardinalInterpolationBias; the exported global squared-deficit bound alone is not that target. No single declaration choosing simultaneous paper constants `C_A,C_I` was independently checked.

results.scope_notes: Quantitative targets in separate parts. Exterior polynomial exactness and exact cosh total variation; largest odd derivative order and exactness through D; fixed quadratic-coefficient rule; covariance support, mass/mean/second moment, variation and linearity. Symmetry and positive frame normalization are explicit as required.

results.scope_notes: Quantitative all-count target; components for the full row lemma. Actual tensor/action/count identity. Arbitrary finite signed updates with measurable legal resets and conditional bounded-Borel affine annihilation have the exact `2*C_q*k²*pPlus^k*eta²*variation` bound, with no frame-dimension factor. The covariance/Hessian exactness is for degree ≤2; the response remainder is separately bounded through the fixed higher Taylor order, as stated in the manuscript.

results.title: Finite bounded hyperplane field and two-pair moment bound
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target, alternative construction. Joint Borel fair-cell field law, exact exponential Euclidean covariance, odd-moment cancellation and true higher-moment L2 bound `C^j*j^4/T^d`. Gaussian-normal hyperplane intensity, normalized by `2*d*gaussianAbsoluteMean`, replaces the paper's uniform sphere normals; exact separation probabilities give the same covariance.

results.title: Pair activity, selected cancellation and higher terms
results.scope_notes: Quantitative pair-norm targets; construction components. Literal nuisance suprema before integration, pair alias zero through M, exact factorial alias tail and both field-energy inequalities. Count-two radial identity is actual source action; its spatial bound includes every N≥1. The frame guard F≥3 preserves the surrounding paper's D≥3 requirement for its quadratic pair kernel.

results.scope_notes: Components; exact activation supremum checked. Absolute reference mixture and disjoint zero-weight branch, mean-zero slope/mean-one intercept, state-independent bounded activation and exact `C_ctr*B_base` supremum, including zero-mass rows. Generic union legality premises are proved by complete source guards.

results.title: Chart ratio, conditional centering and disjoint orthogonality
results.scope_notes: Components. Conditional identities use integration under the actual product ternary response law at each fixed design. Complete sources discharge primitive cancellation and positivity hypotheses. A single exact endpoint for the full lemma, particularly its displayed crude envelope `B_loc*(b_M/(a_M*c_q))^k+k*eta²/(a_Y²*c_q)`, was not independently checked. results.scope_notes: Components of seven clauses. State legality/centering, activity, zero counts and actual defect/alias/field decomposition have supporting declarations. Separate literal component norms exist; aggregate geometry is not substituted for them. No single theorem combining the entire seven-clause paper statement was independently checked.

results.title: Interpolation and fixed-rule Taylor defect energy
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Count-two-through-D factorial sum bounded by `C5*eta^4*mu²*N^-d` under primitive N/mu/log-N/amplitude/Taylor guards; no Reg(K) or desired energy premise. C5 precedes varying frame/selector/density margins and tuple; the density upper cap/frame constant/score coefficient stay fixed. F≥3 and D≤F are explicit; specialize F=D≥3 for the pair construction. Physical nu and one heat correction are retained, including empty scales.

results.title: Global local activity without an M-polynomial loss
results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual source variation and centered activation have fixed `C_B*N²*exp(tau_M*M)` bounds. The final estimate has no additional polynomial-in-M multiplier.

results.scope_notes: Quantitative norm target and source identification. Exact `eta^4*exp(2*tau_M*M)*N^(4-d)*(C6*mu)^(M+1)/(M+1)!` shape with nuisance supremum before integration. Actual aliases are pair and ordinary fine aliases and vanish through M. Infinite alias-tail results are additional formal results.

results.title: Positive path, raw transport and concentrated mass tilt
results.scope_notes: Components. Actual marked histories and positive probability priors, append transport, invariant mass law, mean-one/MGF bounds, true mass tilt and exceptional tail. Generic boundedness/measurability/positivity/concentration hypotheses are discharged for the source. The inspected ordinary derivative endpoint is for `0<t<T`; endpoint behavior/product-rule infrastructure was not reassembled into one exact numbered statement.

results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Intrinsic C_fr, exact rho/2^(d+1) cap, `C_sharp=1/(pLower²*cq)`, actual infinite compact-nuisance norm series and true h^d chart factor. The conclusion bounds MSE, the square of paper RMS, with original variance-width exceptional penalty. Norm finiteness/Fisher/path transfer are proved internally. Positive transfer constant precedes U and all sample/construction parameters.

results.scope_notes: Quantitative target. Actual convergent infinite norm series and exact B²+E1+E2+E3 cost, including M/(M+1)! and D/(D+1)! tail powers, eta=cf*h^s and mu=n*h^d. Fixed C_G and threshold precede the whole tuple/grid. The free score coefficient is specialized to the paper's C_sharp.
